title: State of Kansas dismisses case against Chiefs assistant Dave Merritt

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Charge against Chiefs DBs coach Merritt dropped
sources.description: A misdemeanor domestic battery charge filed last month against Chiefs defensive backs coach Dave Merritt was dismissed Thursday by the District Court of Johnson County (Kansas).
